name: ask-user
title: Ask the user
description: ask_user defers a question (2000 characters), optionally with an app-supplied JSON Schema. The owner calls answer({ threadId, toolCallId, value }); malformed values stay pending. Root-only by default; Agent.askUser can override. No item tables.
docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Register createAskUserTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. Answer with core answer, never by saving a native tool result directly. See /docs/tools/ask-user. Subscribe to pendingApprovals for bounded owned root/child calls. answerSchema supports bounded JSON forms; answer.value replaces answer.text.
